_comment: Both checks verify that the metainfo's media has been mirrored to Flathub's own CDN,
which only Flathub's build infrastructure can do: it downloads the screenshots and
rewrites the catalogue to https://dl.flathub.org/media. A build outside that pipeline
can pass --mirror-screenshots-url and commit the screenshots ref (both are done here),
but the URLs still point at github.com, so these two errors always fire.
This file is NOT the Flathub exception list - it only relaxes our own verification runs.
Everything else the repo lint reports stays a hard failure.

*.appstream-external-screenshot-url: Screenshot mirroring happens in Flathub's build pipeline, not in ours
*.appstream-remote-icon-not-mirrored: Icon mirroring happens in Flathub's build pipeline, not in ours
